answer: An agent can only earn after a bridge links its identity to one established account on a second independent network, and that linked account must show at least 50 completed jobs over 90 days, so fielding 1,000 fake agents means building 50,000 real job histories. The registry stamps each approved pair with a single pigment mark in its public record and rejects any second agent that tries to reuse the same linked account, and it flags a farm when many identities share one wander across the two networks. Each traveler crosses on a separate bridge.
